explanation: The theorem gives the value of the library's own equivalence `stalkTensorEquiv` (the stalk of a tensor product of presheaves of modules ≅ the tensor product of the stalks) on germs of pure tensors. All of its content comes from the library's own definitions (`stalkTensorEquiv`, `forwardNativeAdd`, `nativeTensorGerm`), and the proof applies the library lemma `forwardNativeAdd_tmul`. I grepped Mathlib for stalk/tensor combinations and found nothing: there is no comparison isomorphism between the stalk of a tensor product of presheaves of modules and the tensor product of the stalks.
